title: Private cohort hypothesis catalog and rolling metrics runbook for quarterly roadmap
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a single, prioritized catalog of product hypotheses for Private/VPC/on-prem quarterly experiments, with explicit success metrics, gating criteria, dashboards, and an operator runbook that enables controlled activation for early-access customer cohorts. This ticket consolidates cross-functional input (serving runtime, infra, security, sales) into an experiment playbook we can execute across the quarter and hand off to Dedicated/Private launch squads.
acceptance_criteria: Hypothesis catalog populated with at least 12 experiment entries tied to customer cohorts and business outcomes
Each hypothesis has: problem statement, acceptance metric (primary), guardrail metrics (latency, errors, cost delta), and initial sample size/cohort definition
Dashboard templates (Grafana/Looker) created with at least 6 widgets: activation rate, median/95th latency, error rate, tokens per request, cost per 1k tokens, rollback signal
Runbook drafted with step-by-step activation, canary thresholds, rollback criteria, and escalation contacts
Security review completed and sign-off from security for two representative experiments involving customer-managed KMS
Stakeholder review and verbal sign-off from Sales + Solutions Eng for priority cohorts
tasks: Collect inputs from research/eng about serving constraints and per-token cost impact
Survey top 10 private customers for candidate experiments and acceptance thresholds
Draft hypothesis statements and map to OKRs (throughput, latency, cost reduction, enterprise adoption)
Define cohort activation mechanics: canary size, rollout pace, and circuit-breakers
Create and share dashboard templates and alert definitions
Coordinate security review for KMS/HSM scenarios
Publish the runbook to Confluence and link in Console as activation artifact
Schedule a cross-functional kickoff and weekly measurement sync for first 6 weeks

stakeholders: Head of Product - Private: Priya Desai
decision_log: 2025-11-07: Prioritize output-quality sensitive experiments later in quarter; smoke tests for cost/latency first
2025-11-10: Canary size default set to 5% of customer traffic for cohort experiments unless customer contract requires smaller cohort
2025-11-12: Require security sign-off for experiments that touch customer-managed KMS; mitigation: pre-flight KMS rotation test in staging
risk_register: Customer data exposure risk for early canaries if audit logs not yet segregated - mitigation: enable per-customer audit channel
Regression in generation quality from aggressive quantization - mitigation: add prompt set evals and automatic regression alert
Unexpected cost delta on burst workloads - mitigation: define cost guardrail and automatic throttle at 2x baseline
rollout_steps: 1) Select priority experiments and matching early-access customers
2) Run staging validation with representative prompt sets and collect quality metrics
3) Configure dashboard and alerts, create PagerDuty rotation for experiment owners
4) Activate canary at 1% -> 5% -> 20% cadence with 48h observation windows
5) Evaluate guardrail metrics at each step and decide: continue, pause, or rollback
6) If stability is met, schedule phased expand to remainder of cohort and capture learnings
metrics: Primary metric: activation conversion rate (customer feature toggle turned on -> used at least N times within 7 days)
Quality guardrail: prompt-set pass-rate (>= 98% against baseline evals)
Performance guardrail: median latency delta <= +10ms and p99 delta <= +25ms
Reliability guardrail: error rate increase <= 0.2 percentage points above baseline
Cost guardrail: cost per 1k tokens change <= +15% without documented customer approval
Operational metric: time to rollback <= 30 minutes from alert
